core_obligations: (2)→(1): K gives an exact k-linear F preserving coherent modules via the support-pushforward lemma.
Construct the quasi-inverse: extend F, apply the diagonal lemma for K flat and acyclic, coherence of K via from-separated.
Analyze fibres: F(O_x) = pushforward of K|_{x×Y} with faithful pushforward; a positive-dimensional fibre contradicts coherence of F(O_X) by generator counting.
Conclude Z → Y finite via lemma-characterize-finite.
proof_roadmap: kernel + coherence + skyscraper fibres + generator counting + finiteness criterion
